1479-4862-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4862-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5641-6854-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
5641-6854-7096.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1430-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1430-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1430-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2018-2469-4053.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

81-2034-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
81-2034-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-4365-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7160.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7158.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2438-6529-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

38-883-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

826-1636-5686-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-4766-5222-6797.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-4766-5222-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

5776-5777-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5776-5777-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.

When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.

1170-1418-2733-5954-6664.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1247-5457-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

141-3280.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Croaking Counterpart
141-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of Naru Meha that is a 1/1 Frog.
Put the Naru Meha token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

997-4871-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1068-2103-2660.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1068-2103-2660.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from your library.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-2366-2397-3875.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
1409-2366-2397-3875.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Tireless Provisioner twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2436-3263-3746-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
Robaran Mercenaries has power 5 or greater.
2436-3263-3746-4170.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Marwyn's ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {4}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

248-2034-4681.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing Karmic Guide.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Changeling Berserker, adding {C}{C}.
Changeling Berserker dies, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
